method: Read-only source inspection of the committed repository snapshot and E2 wrapper receipts; no workload/server/browser was run.

workflow.name: benchmark:retained-uploads
workflow.workflowSummary: Prove retained Three storage uploads and profile an ASCII-rich Text on WebGPU and WebGL2.
workflow.dedicatedTestFile: No separate retained-upload *.test.* file is registered; the named workflow script is the entry point.

scene.sourceFreezeEvidence: E2 application-memory-browser-candidate/report.json includes this path and hash; unchangedAfterObservation=true. The file SHA-256 read from the repository snapshot matches.
scene.model: one retained Text inside one TextGroup
scene.text: ASCII characters from .:+*#%@, arranged in 12-character runs with palette-colored spans and line breaks after every four runs.
scene.fontDeliveryEvidence: E2 application-memory-browser-candidate/browser-delivery.json records HTTP 200, model/gltf-binary, 926984 bytes and the fixture SHA for both WebGPU and WebGL2.
scene.usage: stream for main, candidate, and prior-current archive; dynamic for published release, as recorded in E2 starts.

phases.name: idle
phases.operation: Render 30 frames and check upload counters and attribute versions.

phases.name: changedContents
phases.operation: Replace equal-length text with a second ASCII palette phase.

phases.name: resized
phases.operation: Grow to 480 runs and check replacement storage creation.

phases.name: drawReplacement
phases.operation: Change style to underline and check draw topology replacement.

phases.name: transform
phases.operation: Shift text position and check changed retained uploads.

scene.scope: Four-archive Node/browser memory and cold-output comparison through the same committed ASCII-rich retained-upload scene. It provides the six phase output signatures in both browser backends; it is separate from the 12-cell dynamic-layout TSL/TypeGPU presentation matrix.
scene.visualEvidence: Source and delivery evidence establish the ASCII fixture content and font identity. No raw ASCII scene screenshot is included in these records.

presentationMatrixClarification: benchmark:presentation is a separate workflow: 3 techniques × 2 backends × 2 shader implementations = 12 dynamic-layout cells. Do not label those cells as the ASCII scene or as a recovered hero workload.
